ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution across >95% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels are restricted to small-scale linear abrasions and localized clusters at the lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity mass occupying both lobes. Localized high-contrast white clusters at the extreme lateral distal points. Distinct linear high-intensity pixel chains located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped median notch with a pixel-calculated interior angle of approximately 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; trailing edge presents a jagged, 'saw-tooth' profile with multiple distinct peaks and deep valleys across the entire linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the superior margins, tapering to sharp, slightly recurved lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast tan/white circular clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the far-left and far-right lateral fluke tips. Sparse, small-scale circular white spots visible on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least three distinct, parallel high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the right lobe surface; additional shorter, unaligned streaks visible near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on lateral tips; prominent diagonal linear scarring on the right lobe; highly irregular trailing edge suggesting significant past tissue loss or mechanical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge profile compared to standard smooth or moderately serrated fluke types.
